sections.heading: Seasonal Water Damage Risks in Plano, TX

items.title: Spring
items.text: Spring brings North Texas's heaviest thunderstorm activity, with heavy rainfall and occasional hail that can lead to roof leaks and localized flooding in Plano neighborhoods.

items.title: Summer
items.text: Intense summer storms and occasional tropical rain remnants can bring sudden downpours, straining drainage systems and roofing on older Plano homes.

items.title: Fall
items.text: Fall storm systems continue to bring heavy rain to the Plano area, and clogged gutters from falling leaves can contribute to water backing up against rooflines and foundations.

items.title: Winter
items.text: Occasional freezing temperatures in Plano can cause pipes to freeze and burst, particularly in homes with older plumbing, making indoor water damage a winter concern as well.

sections.heading: Water Damage Restoration FAQs for Plano Homeowners

items.q: How quickly should I call for water damage restoration in Plano, TX?
items.a: You should call as soon as you discover water damage. Acting quickly helps limit how far moisture spreads into flooring, walls, and belongings.

items.q: Will my homeowners insurance cover water damage restoration?
items.a: Coverage depends on your specific policy and the cause of the damage. We provide thorough documentation of the damage and our work to support your claim, but approval and coverage decisions are made by your insurance provider.

items.q: What should I do before your team arrives?
items.a: If it's safe to do so, avoid walking through standing water near electrical outlets or appliances, and do not attempt to handle sewage-contaminated water yourself. Our technicians are equipped to manage these hazards safely upon arrival.

items.q: Can all water-damaged materials be saved?
items.a: Some materials, like solid wood furniture or hard flooring, can often be cleaned and dried successfully. Porous materials such as drywall, insulation, and carpet padding usually need to be removed and replaced, especially if contamination is a concern.
